title: Terracoin still contributes Bitcoin witnesses beyond its historical publication
summary: Post-cutoff Terracoin witnesses in May and August 2026 motivate continuous live capture alongside the pinned historical publication.
body:
Terracoin block `3,220,057` commits to canonical Bitcoin block `950,154` (absent from the earlier pinned snapshot), and block `3,288,246` commits to MiningDutch Bitcoin block `964,388` on 28 August 2026.[^1]

Live capture and the refreshed Research publication authenticate both proofs through Bitcoin Core, while cursor and capture-error state track collection health independently of sparse Bitcoin-difficulty wins.
